title: Liars'-Bench Lie-Detector Transfer to a Held-Out Deception Type

original_idea.body: # Liars' Bench Lie-Detector Transfer to a Held-Out Deception Type. Train a lie detector on one deception category and evaluate AUROC on a held-out category; report the cross-category generalization gap. Fully open-data, single-GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: detector coverage gap maps directly to deception-monitoring deployment risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inherited Liars' Bench methodology + linear probes; novice+mentor can execute on single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single train-on-one/test-on-other experiment with clear AUROC metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open data/models, weak lab incentive to map cross-type transfer; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Linear probe on one open model, single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Recent benchmark; cross-category transfer angle likely partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Lie-detector generalization studied but this specific cross-category gap may be open.
